places.name: Flight EK87 DXB→ZRH (A380, Premium Economy)
places.near: DXB dep 08:40 → ZRH arr 13:20 (~6h40)
places.famousFor: Nonstop A380 with Premium Economy on every Zurich rotation since Mar 2026
places.goodToKnow: EES biometric enrolment at ZRH for all 7 (under-12s facial image only) — budget 45–90 min; NO ETIAS needed in Oct 2026 (postponed to 2027 — ignore sites selling it)

places.name: Sixt 9-seat automatic van pickup — ZRH Airport
places.near: Pick up ~14:45 (after EES + bags) — NOT 12:30
places.famousFor: VW Caravelle / Mercedes Vito Tourer class — Sixt Express status
places.goodToKnow: Declare CH/IT/AT/DE at booking + desk (Zone 1, ~CHF 25 cap); ADD winter tyres (~CHF 97 cap) + snow chains (~CHF 25) — October fleet is on summer tyres and you cross two 2,100m+ passes; 2–3 child seats (4yo full seat, 9yo booster; the 12yo: ITALY is height-only <150 cm with no age exemption — measure NOW, it decides a 3rd booster); Swiss vignette included — check windscreen; expect NO roof box → soft bags only (boot fits 2–4 cases with 9 seats up)

places.name: Zurich arrival apartment — Seebach / Kloten
places.famousFor: UP&GREAT 4-bedroom apartment, 140 m², 8 beds, private parking (or Apart-Hotel Zurich Airport)
places.goodToKnow: CHF 979 for 1 night incl. tax (Booking, 22 Sep 2026) — free cancellation only until 25 Sep; city garages cost CHF 45+/night and cap at 2.10 m — airport side is the right call with a van

places.name: Bürkliplatz lake promenade + Lindenhof
places.near: S-Bahn from Zürich-Seebach/Oerlikon (500 m from the apartment) 8 min to HB → tram to Bürkliplatz
places.famousFor: Lakefront square with the Alps view, then the linden-shaded hilltop over the Limmat
places.goodToKnow: Free; sunset 18:51; easy jet-lag stroll — Augustinergasse lane + Schipfe on the way

places.name: Haus Hiltl
places.order: Buffet: Indian curries, Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veg), desserts
places.famousFor: World's oldest vegetarian restaurant — weigh-and-pay buffet, 100+ dishes
places.goodToKnow: Open daily from 06:00 — perfect jet-lag dinner: no pork/alcohol question, five kids pick their own plates

places.name: Sprüngli Paradeplatz
places.order: Assorted Luxemburgerli box, hot chocolate
places.famousFor: Luxemburgerli mini-macarons
places.goodToKnow: Fri 08:30–18:30; eat Luxemburgerli same day — buy the Dubai box at HB/airport on the 18th instead

places.name: Coop Pfäffikon SZ Seedamm — chalet grocery run
places.famousFor: Big Coop directly on the A3 lake route — stock the Engadin chalet
places.goodToKnow: Sat 08:00–18:00; leave Seebach ~09:00, shop 09:30–10:15, on the road by 10:15 (late-ish start after the flight). SUNDAY 11 OCT EVERYTHING IS CLOSED in Switzerland — buy for two days incl. a picnic for Monday's Glurns stop

places.name: Drive Zurich → Julier Pass → Engadin (~3h)
places.near: A3 → A13 → Thusis → Julier → Silvaplana → Celerina
places.famousFor: One of the few Swiss passes kept open year-round
places.goodToKnow: Check alpen-paesse.ch / TCS pass status the morning of; chains may be ordered for short spells after snow. SNOW PLAN B: Vereina car train Klosters–Sagliains (18 min, no pass) via A28 Prättigau. Arrive Engadin ~13:30 — check-in is 16:00–20:00, so lunch + Staz walk first

places.name: Chesa Ronchi — Celerina (Engadin chalet, 2 nights)
places.famousFor: 4-bedroom / 3-bath apartment, 120 m², 7 beds, FREE outdoor parking (no garage height issue)
places.goodToKnow: CHF 1,120 for 2 nights incl. tax (Booking, 22 Sep 2026); free cancel until 26 Sep; CHF 500 deposit; check-in 16:00–20:00. ASK if it participates in 'Bergbahnen inklusive' (free lifts for 2+ nights, valid to 31 Oct) — worth CHF 500–900 for 7. NOTHING for 7 left in Pontresina itself; Residence Miragolf (Madulain, CHF 965) is the alternative — '1 left'

places.name: Restaurant Lej da Staz — lakeside lunch
places.area: Lej da Staz, between St. Moritz and Pontresina
places.order: Sharing plates, Rösti, kids' pasta
places.famousFor: Lakeside restaurant with a small playground — the first Engadin meal
places.goodToKnow: ~13:45 after the pass; verify autumn hours (Laudinella is open year-round)

places.name: Lej da Staz / Stazerwald larch walk
places.near: Park at Punt Muragl (free) or St. Moritz Bad, wide gravel path
places.famousFor: Golden larch-and-pine forest to a jewel lake — the gentle Engadin welcome
places.goodToKnow: ~90 min round trip, stroller-OK, playground; larches turn top-down so early-October gold is best higher up

places.name: Hatecke — Bündnerfleisch (St. Moritz)
places.order: Bündnerfleisch (beef ✓); avoid Salsiz (pork mix)
places.famousFor: Switzerland's finest air-dried BEEF, sliced tissue-thin — the Engadin edible souvenir
places.goodToKnow: Sat 10:00–18:00, CLOSED Sunday — today or never; personal-use meat from Switzerland is allowed into the EU within value limits (€300–430/person)

places.name: Coop Pontresina — top-up before Sunday
places.famousFor: Last shop before the Swiss Sunday shutdown
places.goodToKnow: Sat 08:00–18:00; CLOSED Sunday — shop ~17:00, then check-in Chesa Ronchi ~17:30 (window 16:00–20:00)

places.name: Restaurant Gondolezza — fondue in an old gondola
places.order: Cheese fondue (ask it made WITHOUT kirsch), raclette; skip the meat-broth fondue
places.famousFor: Cheese fondue served inside a retired cable-car cabin — the kids' Engadin night
places.goodToKnow: Wed–Sun 18:00–21:00 (season to 18 Oct); dinner only; book for 7. Premium adults+teens option the same night: Kronenstübli at Grand Hotel Kronenhof (16 GaultMillau, Tue–Sat 19:00 only → Saturday is its only possible night, +41 81 830 30 30) — a 3-hour tasting room, not for the 4-year-old

places.name: Hanselmann — Engadiner Nusstorte
places.order: Engadiner Nusstorte (buy a whole one for Italy), Prinzess Mandeln, hot chocolate
places.famousFor: The caramelised-walnut tart that defines the Engadin
places.goodToKnow: Sat visit after Hatecke (same street); also open SUNDAY 07:30–19:00 if a café breakfast is wanted before Diavolezza

places.name: Diavolezza cable car (2,978 m)
places.near: Free parking at the valley station; first ascent 07:40
places.famousFor: Glacier amphitheatre of Piz Palü and Piz Bernina — max wow per unit of effort
places.goodToKnow: Autumn block runs ONLY to 16 Oct (you're inside it); LAST DESCENT 16:20; sub-zero + wind at 3,000 m — winter jackets/gloves for all 7; 4-YEAR-OLD: cap the summit stay at 1.5–2 h, keep hydrated, descend at once on headache/vomiting; lunch at Berghaus Diavolezza (08:30–16:00) — Rösti with egg+cheese is the safe order

places.name: Morteratsch larch stroll (short)
places.near: Park at Morteratsch station
places.famousFor: The golden larch valley below the glacier — 45-min photo stroll, not a hike
places.goodToKnow: Flat gravel, stroller-OK; walk ~1 km in and turn back (full glacier trail is 5.8 km — skip); shoot along the river for reflections. NOT an anchor — a 45-min add-on after Diavolezza lunch

places.name: PLAN B — Val Roseg horse-drawn omnibus
places.near: Departs Pontresina station 10:10/11:10/12:10; returns 13:45/14:45/15:45
places.famousFor: The most 4-year-old-proof Engadin outing: 70-min carriage up a larch-lined car-free valley, salad-buffet lunch, carriage back
places.goodToKnow: Use INSTEAD of Diavolezza if the summit is clouded or the 4yo shouldn't go to 3,000 m; season to 18 Oct; CASH ONLY (adult CHF 37 return / child 4–12 CHF 18.50); RESERVE for 7 by 18:00 the day before (+41 78 944 75 55)

places.name: Rest block at the chalet
places.goodToKnow: Valley light dies ~17:00 in October — rest before the sunset ride

places.name: Muottas Muragl funicular + Panorama Restaurant sunset dinner
places.near: FREE large car park at Punt Muragl valley station
places.order: Capuns (ask vegetarian), Bündner barley soup (ask no pork), Rösti; kids' plates
places.famousFor: The signature Engadin lake-chain view from 2,456 m — zero walking, the funicular does it all
places.goodToKnow: Runs to 25 Oct; departures :15/:45, evening service to 23:00; book the dinner for 7 — Sunday is the thinnest restaurant night in the Engadin. Second anchor of the day (the funicular is the activity). Rainy-day alternative for the whole day: Bernina regional train Pontresina→Alp Grüm (no reservation, ~CHF 224–308 cheaper than Bernina Express for 7)

places.name: Drive Pontresina → Zernez → Ofenpass → Müstair (~1h30)
places.near: Leave ~09:00 after checkout; fuel up in Samedan/St. Moritz Bad first — stations thin out past Zernez
places.famousFor: Year-round pass through the National Park with Ortler views
places.goodToKnow: Swiss customs border at Müstair/Taufers: Schengen (no stamp) but a CUSTOMS line — personal-use food from Switzerland is fine within the EU value allowance (€300 by car / €430 per person); passports handy

places.name: Kloster St. Johann, Müstair (UNESCO)
places.area: Müstair, 5 min before the Italian border
places.famousFor: Charlemagne-era Carolingian frescoes — the largest surviving cycle anywhere
places.goodToKnow: Open Monday 09:00–18:00 (364 days/yr); 45–60 min is enough; real substance for the teens

places.name: Glurns / Glorenza — walled-town stroll + picnic lunch
places.area: Val Venosta, 15 min past the border
places.order: Picnic from Saturday's Coop run on the town walls (Flurin, the Michelin tower restaurant, is CLOSED Mon & Tue — reviewer-verified)
places.famousFor: Italy's smallest fully-walled medieval town — three gate towers, arcades, 30-min loop
places.goodToKnow: Rain backup: drive on to Merano old town (+1 h, many Monday options) — accept the longer day only if the weather forces it

places.name: Drive Glurns → Merano → Bolzano → Val Gardena (~2h15)
places.near: Val Venosta down to Merano, A22 south past Bolzano, exit Ponte Gardena/Chiusa, SS242 up to Ortisei
places.goodToKnow: Total Pontresina→Ortisei ≈ 200 km / 3h driving; with Müstair + lunch = 6–7 h door to door, arrive ~16:00; A22 Chiusa–Bolzano toll ~€3–4 by card at the barrier

places.name: Chalet Bel Plan — Ortisei (Dolomites chalet, 3 nights)
places.area: 1.7 km from centre, 2 km to Mont Sëuc cable car
places.famousFor: 3-bedroom / 3-bath chalet, 81 m², 7 beds, hot tub, FREE on-site parking
places.goodToKnow: €2,114 for 3 nights incl. tax (Booking, 22 Sep 2026) — cancellation policy varies by rate: CHOOSE THE FREE-CANCELLATION RATE if offered; coded max 5 adults + 2 children (17yo counts as child <18: confirm in writing). ORTISEI IS 92% SOLD OUT for your dates — book FIRST. Van height: Ortisei garages (Mont Sëuc/Seceda) publish no clearance — a Caravelle is ~1.99 m; the chalet's free outdoor parking avoids the question. Alternatives: Casa Roder ×2 apartments 50 m from centre (€2,154); Villa Vastle 300 m² premium (€3,220, NON-refundable)

places.name: Despar Dolomiti — Ortisei grocery
places.famousFor: The in-town supermarket
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:15–19:15; do the chalet shop Monday evening

places.name: Mauriz Keller
places.order: Cheese or spinach Schlutzkrapfen, spinach Knödel, pizza for the kids
places.famousFor: Vaulted rustic-elegant cellar restaurant — YOUR note: 'مطعم ايطالي لذيذ'
places.goodToKnow: Ask for the no-speck versions of Knödel/Schlutzkrapfen (speck is in almost everything by default)

places.name: Caffè Corso — breakfast
places.order: Cappuccino + brioche, apple strudel
places.famousFor: Ortisei's long-running café, terrace over the church
places.goodToKnow: Wide selection of coffees, chocolates and teas; popular pre-ski stop in the pedestrian centre

places.name: Alpe di Siusi via Mont Sëuc cable car
places.near: Mont Sëuc gondola 08:30–18:00 (to 16 Oct) — DO NOT drive up: private cars barred 09:00–17:00, P2 Compatsch €30/day
places.order: Wide sweep of meadow leading to the jagged Sassolungo; isolated mountain huts and grazing scenes at sunrise.
places.famousFor: Europe's largest high-alpine meadow (56 km²) under Sassolungo — best 4-year-old fit of the whole trip
places.goodToKnow: Runs to 2 Nov; flat gravel tracks between huts, stroller-passable; October cures the meadow grass to gold even before larch peak; 3–5 h incl. hut lunch. Family return fare ≈ €65 on the Siusi side (Mont Sëuc price: confirm at station)
places.address: Alpe di Siusi, Provincia autonoma di Bolzano - Alto Adige, Italy

places.name: Lunch on the Alp — Mont Sëuc top station / Compatsch huts
places.order: Cheese Knödel, Kaiserschmarrn, Gerstensuppe (ask no speck)
places.famousFor: Hut lunch on the meadow with Sassolungo in front — walkable from the top station
places.goodToKnow: Walk-in huts near Compatsch (Sanon / Ritsch — check seiseralm.it/huts for October days); PREMIUM OPTION: Gostner Schwaige (chef Franz Mulser, 25 covers, Fri–Wed 11:00–16:30) is ~4 km away on the Saltria side — reach it by shuttle bus 11 from Compatsch, RESERVE +39 347 8368154 and confirm it is still open mid-Oct

places.name: Rest block at the chalet (hot tub)
Ortisei old town + woodcarving galleries
places.near: Garage Central / Mont Sëuc garage → escalators (ideal with the 4-year-old)
places.famousFor: One of the longest pedestrian streets in the Dolomites, linked by escalators + 'La Curta' moving walkway
places.goodToKnow: Museum Gherdëina is CLOSED mid-Oct→Nov — use the carving workshops/galleries along Strada Rezia instead; 1.5 h

places.name: Tubladel
places.order: Charcoal-grilled fish/veal, homemade pasta, game for the teens
places.famousFor: Chef Gerardo Spinelli; 4.4/5 over 2,500 reviews; the Ortisei dinner locals recommend
places.goodToKnow: Book for 7. Premium alternative: Anna Stuben (1 Michelin star, Gardena Grödnerhof, Mon–Sat 19:00–21:00, +39 0471 796315) — better as an adults+teens night

places.name: Seceda cable car (2,500 m ridge)
places.area: Ortisei — Garage Seceda, S.da Val d'Anna
places.near: Two-stage lift from Ortisei (Furnes → Seceda), 250+ parking spaces
places.order: The cable car/gondola up to ~2,500 m and the dramatic Seceda ridgeline viewpoint
places.famousFor: The jagged Odle ridge — the Dolomites' most famous view; YOUR note: 'only worthwhile in clear weather'
places.goodToKnow: Open to 2 Nov but hours/fares unpublished → CALL +39 0471 796 531; decide on the morning webcam; 4-year-old fine at the top station + first 10–15 min of the ridge only — exposed, windy, may be frozen mid-Oct. Cloudy Plan B: Col Raiser gondola (S. Cristina, gentler meadow, open to 1 Nov)

places.name: Sofie Hütte (Seceda) / Rifugio Col Raiser — mountain lunch
places.area: Seceda plateau or Col Raiser top station
places.order: Cheese Knödel, Kaiserschmarrn, Gerstensuppe (ask no speck)
places.famousFor: Terrace huts under the Odle — pick whichever lift the weather chose
places.goodToKnow: Rifugi are cash-friendly — carry €; confirm October opening days on arrival

places.name: St. Johann in Ranui, Val di Funes — larch + church photo
places.area: Val di Funes, ~40 min from Ortisei
places.near: Drive via Ponte Gardena → Funes; small viewpoint fee ~€4 (your note)
places.famousFor: The tiny onion-domed church under the Odle — Val di Funes is a strong larch valley in mid-October
places.goodToKnow: Best light 17:00–18:20 (sunset 18:25); pair with Santa Maddalena viewpoint; 20-min flat walks only

places.name: Vedl Mulin — pizza night for 7
places.order: Margherita/veg pizzas, pasta; alt: Turonda Pizza Bistrot (best Neapolitan in the north)
places.famousFor: 'Good for groups' — the natural table-for-7 pizzeria
places.goodToKnow: Heart of Val Gardena, great location; pasta mains ~€20-24; good for groups

places.name: Drive Ortisei → A22 → Brenner → Innsbruck bypass → Seefeld → Mittenwald (~3h15)
places.area: A22 · A13 Brenner · A12 · B177 Zirler Berg · B2
places.near: Leave 08:30; A22 toll ~€7–9 at the barrier (card); A13 Brenner section toll €12.50 at Schönberg (NOT covered by vignette); buy the AUSTRIAN 1-DAY digital vignette (€9.60, valid immediately) at shop.asfinag.at against the van's plate — it covers today's only tolled stretch (A12 Innsbruck→Zirl); Saturday's A14 Vorarlberg section is vignette-free
places.goodToKnow: Budget 5–5.5 h door to door with lunch; Zirler Berg 16% gradient is fine for a van; Germany has border controls (extended to Mar 2027) — passports in the glovebox at Scharnitz

places.name: Mittenwald — painted-house lunch stop (Gasthaus Alpenrose)
places.famousFor: Violin-making town with the best Lüftlmalerei façades in Bavaria
places.goodToKnow: Arrive ~12:30, walk Obermarkt, lunch at Gasthaus Alpenrose (historic painted inn on Obermarkt — verify Thursday hours; order Forelle / Käsespätzle), in Garmisch by 15:00; Das Marktrestaurant (1 Michelin star) is dinner-only Wed–Sat

places.name: Höllental heritage House — Garmisch (chalet, 2 nights)
places.famousFor: 4-bedroom, 120 m², exactly 7 beds, FREE on-site parking, 200 m from centre
places.goodToKnow: €834 for 2 nights incl. tax (Booking, 22 Sep 2026) — FREE cancellation until 14 Oct = zero-risk hold, book today; Garmisch is 97% sold out. Alt: Golden GaPa Duplex (€716)

places.name: Rest block at the chalet — settle in
places.goodToKnow: After a 5-hour border-crossing day: no anchor this afternoon. Optional ONLY if energy is high: Linderhof Venus Grotto — 15 Oct is its LAST day of 2026 (leave by 14:45, 30 min away)

places.name: REWE Hauptstraße — chalet shop
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 07:00–20:00, CLOSED Sunday

places.name: Gasthof Fraundorfer — Schuhplattler night
places.order: Käsespätzle, Forelle Müllerin, Kaiserschmarrn (ask ohne Rum); skip the pork-heavy carte
places.famousFor: Free live music + Schuhplattler dancing Thu–Mon from 19:00 — the kids' Bavaria memory
places.goodToKnow: Thu 17:00–23:00, show from 19:00, kitchen to 21:00; RESERVE (+49 8821 9270) — fills on show nights; Schmalz (lard) is used for frying in traditional houses — ask

places.name: Zugspitze — Eibsee cable car up, cogwheel train down
places.near: Leave 07:45 → Eibsee Hotel lot by 08:05 (early-bird €2.50 before 09:30) → first car 08:30 (10 min, 3,213 m free span)
places.famousFor: Germany's summit (2,962 m): four countries, 400 peaks, Germany/Austria border on the terrace, snow guaranteed
places.goodToKnow: One 'Ticket Zugspitze' = up + down mixing cable car / cogwheel; FAMILY TARIFF: adults €78, kids 6–18 €12.50, under-6 free → €206 for 7 (vs €437) — buy all in ONE transaction. Read the summit webcam at 07:15 (inversion days = grey valley, brilliant summit). Cable car 08:30–16:45; keep the 4yo's summit stay ≤1.5 h then drop to the Zugspitzplatt (2,600 m) for snow play

places.name: Restaurant Sonnalpin — glacier plateau lunch
places.order: Soup, Käsespätzle, Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Year-round glacier restaurant beside Germany's highest chapel
places.goodToKnow: 08:45–16:00 — take an early lunch ~11:15; Gletscherbahn down from summit 08:45–16:25; cogwheel train back to Eibsee ~12:00

places.name: Eibsee shoreline photo stop
places.area: Grainau — at the cable-car valley station
places.famousFor: Turquoise lake under the Zugspitze, right where the cogwheel train drops you
places.goodToKnow: 20-min lakeside stop ~12:30 (the 7-km loop is for another life; boats CLOSED since 4 Oct) → drive to Partenkirchen for Jumu'ah

places.name: Jumu'ah — DITIB Mimar Sinan Camii
places.famousFor: Garmisch's main mosque
places.goodToKnow: Dhuhr ~13:05 CEST → Friday prayer likely ~13:15–13:45 — CALL AHEAD for the khutbah time (no number published; ask the chalet host / moscheesuche.de); the early Zugspitze plan gets you down by ~12:30. Partnach Gorge is 5 min from here

places.name: Partnach Gorge (Partnachklamm)
places.area: Olympic ski stadium, P21 (~€5) — 5 min from the mosque
places.near: 25-min flat walk from the stadium (horse carriages wait behind it — ideal for the 4-year-old)
places.famousFor: Wet, dark slot canyon with tunnels and walkways — kids love it, better in rain
places.goodToKnow: ~15:30–17:30; Oct 08:00–18:00, last entry 17:30; €10 adult / €5 child 6–17 / under 6 free (= €40 for 7); STROLLERS BANNED — carrier for the 4yo; hooded waterproofs + grippy shoes; Vordergraseck loop closed 21 Sep–20 Nov → out-and-back. Second anchor of the day

places.name: Kaffeehaus Krönner
places.order: Cakes, handmade chocolates as gifts home
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 09:30–18:30, closed Sunday

places.name: Joseph Naus Stub'n — Hotel Zugspitze
places.order: Saibling (char), Forelle, Schwammerl dishes, Apfelstrudel mit Vanillesauce
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand — best quality-per-euro in town, open daily, easy with children
places.goodToKnow: Daily 12–14 / 18–21:30, +49 8821 9010; premium alternative: Husar (Michelin-listed, Tue–Sat 18:00, +49 8821 9677922)

places.name: Drive Garmisch → Ettal → Steingaden → Hohenschwangau (~1h20)
places.near: Depart 08:30 (REWE opens 07:00 for breakfast supplies); park P4 Hohenschwangau €12 (closest to the ticket centre/Alpsee) ~09:50
places.goodToKnow: E-tickets = no ticket-centre queue; 09:50 arrival gives 1 h 50 before an 11:40 slot — enough for carriage/bus + Marienbrücke + the 15-min walk down to the gate

places.name: Neuschwanstein Castle — 11:40 tour (BOOK TODAY)
places.near: Shuttle bus €3.50/€5 return (winter service limited, NOT in snow/ice) or horse carriage €8 up (all year, on demand) — then 15-min walk; Marienbrücke photo first, then descend to the gate
places.order: Tour of Neuschwanstein Castle and the Marienbrücke viewpoint
places.famousFor: Ludwig II's fairy-tale castle, UNESCO since 2025
places.goodToKnow: 17 Oct = day 2 of WINTER hours (tours 10:00–16:00 only, fewer slots) → book the 11:40–12:00 slot at the OFFICIAL shop today (NOT 10:00–11:00 — no buffer for a bus that may not run): adults €21 + €2.50 fee, under-18 FREE (still need a ticket) ≈ €59.50 for 7; e-ticket QR on phone (screenshot — no signal in the gorge); non-refundable; no prams inside; Marienbrücke usually open in Oct — check the homepage that morning

places.name: Louis II — Hotel Das Rübezahl
places.area: Am Ehberg 31, 6 min from the castle car parks
places.near: Schwangau, between Fussen and the Ammergau mountains; opposite Neuschwanstein Castle
places.order: Lunch menu: lake fish, regional veg; kids' plates
places.famousFor: Castle-view fine lunch — YOUR saved hotel
places.goodToKnow: Lunch 12:00–14:00 daily, open to non-residents — reserve for 7 at 13:00 (phone +49 8362 8888 or TheFork); tour ends ~12:15, down + 6-min drive; depart 14:00

places.name: Drive Füssen → Lindau → A14 (toll-free) → St. Margrethen → Zurich (~3h15)
places.near: Depart 14:00 → Zurich ~17:30 (Kronenhalle at 19:30 is comfortable)
places.goodToKnow: AUSTRIA: A14 from Hörbranz through the Pfändertunnel to Hohenems is vignette-FREE — set nav to 'avoid tolls' and EXIT AT HOHENEMS/DIEPOLDSAU; overshooting past Altach = Ersatzmaut ~€120 on the spot (more if unpaid). Swiss re-entry at Diepoldsau: customs (declare >CHF 150/person purchases); vignette already on the van

places.name: Zurich departure apartment — Seebach (Sunday-proof)
places.famousFor: Basic Flat ×2 three-bedroom apartments (6 BR, 8 beds) or VISIMO Kloten studios
places.goodToKnow: Basic Flat ×2 = CHF 600 / VISIMO Kloten = CHF 475 (Booking, 22 Sep 2026) — choose the refundable rate; the Friday 4-BR unit is already gone for this night — proof these move; airport side again: 07:45 Rhine Falls departure + 11:30 van return; check-out 07:30 needs bags packed Saturday night

places.name: Globus Bahnhofstrasse (optional, open to 20:00 Sat)
places.order: Latest fashion & largest shoe department in Switzerland, ground-floor Luxury Boulevard brands, beauty across six levels, design homeware (Alessi, Vitra, Bodum), and DELICATESSA Food & Wine
places.famousFor: Six-floor department store; Delicatessa basement for edible gifts
places.goodToKnow: Only if you arrive ~17:30 with energy — 45 min before Kronenhalle; boutiques are shut by then, Globus/Jelmoli run to 20:00

places.name: Kronenhalle
places.cuisine: Zurich institution since 1924 (Chagall & Picasso on the walls)
places.order: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veal), lake fish, mousse au chocolat
places.famousFor: The iconic Zurich dinner — Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with Rösti
places.goodToKnow: Daily 12:00–24:00; BOOK NOW for 7 on a Saturday — hardest table of the trip; backup Zunfthaus zur Waag (1315 guild house); kids' option Raclette Factory all-you-can-eat

places.name: Rhine Falls — Schloss Laufen + Rock Experience boat
places.near: Leave 07:45 → park Schloss Laufen ~08:30 (car tariff up to 2.90 m: CHF 5 first hour); platforms open 24h; ferry Nr.2 to Wörth 09:10 → Rock Experience 09:30
places.famousFor: Europe's most powerful waterfall — platforms over the water + boat to the rock in the middle
places.goodToKnow: 18 OCT IS THE LAST DAY of the 09:30 first boat (from 19 Oct it's 11:00 — re-verify rhyfall-maendli.ch the week before); Rock ride from CHF 22.50, 100+ steps, not recommended under 1.20 m — a 4yo is ~105 cm, so ONE PARENT STAYS ASHORE with the child on the Belvedere platform while the other five ride; castle CHF 5 / child 3; panorama lift back up. Depart 10:45 → ZRH 11:25. Bad weather: Lindt Home of Chocolate, Kilchberg (Sun 10–19, book slot)
